title: shared_vectors.rs: l2_payload test missing sos kind arm (panics on sos_alert_dispatch)
description: 3x codereview on b7z9.120 (correctness finding 1, P1): rust/lichen-link/tests/shared_vectors.rs:819-830 test_l2_payload_vectors match on vector.kind had no "sos" arm, so the new sos_alert_dispatch vector hit the _ catch-all and failed the shared-vector test. Fixed in this diff: added "sos" => Some(0x16) arm (0x14/0x15 literal style).
close_reason: Verified fixed on HEAD (009095c96c): rust/lichen-link/tests/shared_vectors.rs:822 now has the "sos" => Some(0x16) arm; shared_vectors test passes 4/4 including sos_alert_dispatch.
